titleZh: 給予 ↔ 剝奪｜禮物桌對沒收筐
hook: endow／bestow 把禮物擺上桌，divest／despoil／bereave 把東西丟進沒收筐——禮賓說：進門有禮，出門看筐。
script: 給予隊：endow／bestow／confer／grant。剝奪隊：divest／despoil／bereave／disenfranchise／deprive。口令：禮物桌寫「給你能耐」，沒收筐寫「先收回資格」。

members.speakLineEn: The alumni agreed to endow a scholarship for first-generation students.
members.speakLineZh: 校友們同意捐贈一筆獎學金，資助第一代大學生。

related.synonyms: indue, gift, empower, invest, endue, dower

members.speakLineEn: The mayor will bestow an honorary medal on the volunteer firefighters.
members.speakLineZh: 市長將授予義務消防隊員榮譽獎章。

members.speakLineEn: The board voted to grant the researchers full access to the archive.
members.speakLineZh: 董事會投票同意授予研究人員完整檔案查閱權。

members.speakLineEn: Many neighbors donate winter coats to the shelter every December.
members.speakLineZh: 許多鄰居每年十二月都會把冬衣捐贈給收容所。

members.speakLineEn: In her will she chose to bequeath the piano to her youngest niece.
members.speakLineZh: 她在遺囑裡決定把鋼琴遺贈給最小的姪女。

members.speakLineEn: The board of trustees divested $20 million in real estate property.
Invaders threatened to despoil the temple of its ancient treasures.
members.speakLineZh: 侵略者揚言要掠奪神廟裡的古代珍寶。

related.synonyms: plunder, loot, reave, strip, rifle, ransack

members.speakLineEn: The sudden illness bereaved the village of its only doctor overnight.
members.speakLineZh: 突如其來的疾病一夜之間剝奪了村莊唯一的醫生。

members.speakLineEn: New ID rules could disenfranchise elderly voters who lack recent photos.
members.speakLineZh: 新的身分證明規定可能剝奪沒有近期照片的年長選民的投票權。

members.speakLineEn: The storm stripped the paint from the wooden fence in a single night.
members.speakLineZh: 暴風雨一夜之間就把木柵欄上的油漆剝去了。

members.speakLineEn: Customs officers confiscate undeclared cash at the airport border.
members.speakLineZh: 海關人員在機場邊境沒收未申報的現金。

related.synonyms: impound, attach, sequester, seize, forfeit, forfeited

members.speakLineEn: She wrapped a small gift for her tutor before the final class.
members.speakLineZh: 期末課前，她為導師包了一份小禮物。

members.speakLineEn: He carried a wicker basket filled with fresh pears from the orchard.
members.speakLineZh: 他提著一個裝滿果園新鮮梨子的柳條筐。

members.speakLineEn: Each citizen marked a secret ballot and dropped it into the box.
members.speakLineZh: 每位公民在祕密選票上作記號，再投入票箱。

members.speakLineEn: His will left the lakeside cabin to his sister and her children.
members.speakLineZh: 他的遺囑把湖邊小屋留給妹妹和她的孩子們。

members.speakLineEn: She slipped the spare key deep into her coat pocket before leaving.
members.speakLineZh: 出門前，她把備用鑰匙深深塞進大衣口袋。

members.speakLineEn: Without the brass key, nobody could open the locked classroom cabinet.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有那把銅鑰匙，誰也打不開上鎖的教室櫃。

members.speakLineEn: A night guard walked the museum halls with a flashlight and radio.
members.speakLineZh: 夜班警衛提著手電筒和對講機巡視博物館走廊。
